title: Invite adds a viewer by Tailscale login, copies one message and revokes their access
description: The served dashboard uses the real invite and revoke routes against isolated Postgres, a stub tailscale and the install's serve socket: Setup has no invite section; the operator opens Invite in the top bar, invites sam@example.com as viewer and copies one message with the machine share and this install's address and no Graphyard sign-in link. sam's browser, carried to the serve socket with her Tailscale login, is signed in as a viewer with no Invite; the dialog still lists her after reload; Revoke refuses her next request at once. teammate-invite-roles remains the CLI sign-in link coverage.

steps.name: Invite and revoke through the top bar dialog and the serve socket
